class.name: SteamMusic
class.brief_description: Queries and controls the optional Steam client music player.
class.description: Use [method SteamClient.music] after boot. [constant OK] on a control acknowledges submission. Controls return [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when Steam Music is disabled.

method.name: next
method.description: Requests the next track in the current Steam queue.

method.name: pause
method.description: Requests a pause of the current Steam queue.

method.name: play
method.description: Requests resume or playback of the current Steam queue.

method.name: previous
method.description: Requests the previous track in the current Steam queue.

method.name: set_volume
method.description: Requests the normalized volume [param level] from 0 through 1.

method.name: status
method.description: Reads the player's enabled state, playback state, and volume.

signal.name: playback_changed
signal.description: Emitted after Steam reports a playback change. Read the new state with [method status].

signal.name: volume_changed
signal.description: Emitted with the normalized volume reported by Steam.
